name: 69163 · Stapleton, NE
findings: ZIP 69163 (Stapleton) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 69163 (Stapleton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
